reason: The finding holds, but it is a small, zero-cost process fix, not a score item. (1) The 08:32:12Z text in ledger.md comes from runtime_ledger.py l.294-300 (K2_WATCH_H=(7.0,8.5)). It is only a minimum and is printed only while K2 is PENDING, so it is weaker than V7 (CONTEXT l.2046) rather than contradicting it. V6 already makes ledger.md report-only. The 'inconsistent' part is therefore mild. (2) The 'incomplete' part is real. lb_poll.py is a `while True` loop with no stop of its own, so the only risk is a human or agent stopping it, or its host session dying, once V7 is satisfied (~08:00-09:40Z). No rule or ledger text covers a C2(a) resubmit, K1 or K2'' submitted later on 26 Sep. The ledger's gap warning (l.272) only fires when the ledger runs, and the ledger only runs from the poller, so a dead poller goes unnoticed. The stake: R5 (l.1653-1657) takes latency only from our 10-min poll. For K1 and the C2(a) resubmit, R5(b) with F=7.87 h would probably still admit them, so the loss there is small. K2'' (V3, l.2044) requires L(K2'')_hi <= 10.5 h and offers no R5(b) route. Also, K2'' is only built when the forecast has already failed (L(K2) > 8 h). A gap across submit+10.5 h would therefore cost K2'' its F1 eligibility. (3) Feasibility is fine: the fix is a CONTEXT text line with no code, so it respects the 07:45-08:35Z freeze and R1-R10. Editing the ledger text later needs no poller restart, because runtime_ledger.py runs as a fail-soft subprocess on each poll. Contingent value only: P(any later 26 Sep submission) is roughly 0.2-0.4.
fix: Append to CONTEXT instead of the proposed text: 'POLLER STOP RULE (extends V7; ledger.md's "keep until 08:32:12Z" is only a minimum and is superseded): keep experiments/lb_poll/lb_poll.py running (currently PID 20052; name the script, not the PID) until every submission made on or after 26 Sep is COMPLETE or ERROR in poll.log, and for any still PENDING at least until the first poll after submit + 9.5 h (safetail/K1/C2(a)) or + 10.5 h (exp58d K2''). Before each new submission, check that the last poll in poll.log is < 15 min old; if it is not, restart the poller (one instance only; never import lb_poll.py) before submitting. If the poller dies mid-watch, restart it at once and record the gap: R5(a) for that file is then decided by the ledger bounds, and by R5(b) where allowed (not for K2'').' In W59 (after ~09:40Z), replace the K2-only keep text in runtime_ledger.py with a generic one: for every PENDING safetail/safetail_noins/safetail_late entry, print 'keep until submit + deadline_h'. Add a test. No poller restart is needed, since the ledger runs as a subprocess on each poll.
realistic_gain: No LB or private score gain. It protects the R5(a) admissibility read of a contingent late 26 Sep file. That matters in practice only for K2'' (V3 needs L_hi <= 10.5 h, no R5(b)). For K1 and the C2(a) resubmit, R5(b) with F=7.87 h would probably admit them anyway. Expected value is tiny (P(later submission) ~0.2-0.4 x P(poller stopped or dead across the deadline) ~0.1). The cost is about 2 minutes of text, so it is worth doing.
